dedupe_keys.name: stromnetz berlin network structure data netzstrukturdaten circuit lengths capacity losses peak load and feed in 2006 onwards

description: The network structure data of Stromnetz Berlin GmbH give an overview of how the distribution network is built. Technical data include circuit lengths, installed capacities, the number of withdrawal points and average losses per network and transformation level; energy data include the amount and average purchase price of loss energy, the annual energy withdrawn per network and transformation level, the annual peak load with its time of occurrence, the maximum withdrawal load, supply from the upstream transmission network of 50Hertz Transmission GmbH and monthly feed-in per network level. Data start in 2006 and are provided as an Excel file from the operator's publication obligations pages; the Berlin open data register lists the entry under a CC BY licence with metadata last modified on 29 March 2022. Coverage is the Berlin distribution network. Data are free. Caveats: the figures are aggregated per voltage level, not network topology, and the register entry has not been refreshed since 2022, so newer years should be checked on the operator site. Simulation uses are calibration of Berlin distribution network size, loads and losses by voltage level for network and planning models. Related records: data-berlin-energy-networks-district-heating-gas-proximity covers heat and gas network proximity in Berlin.
